error_analysis.question: For Lockheed Martin Space Systems, what was the percentage change in operating profit from 2010 to 2011?

limitations: Ten development positives and two negatives; no reserved cases or independent accuracy estimate.
One sequential lexical/semantic pass per protocol; ordering and provider variability confound causal attribution.
Pacing applies to the sequential evaluator, not cross-process rate reservation or the HTTP service.
Units/scales and explicit period years are checked; this does not independently validate every date, financial scope or source truth.
Historical failures remain; no automatic model retries, billing changes or allowance reset occurred.
A further full twelve-generation campaign currently exceeds remaining worst-case local allowance.
